faq.html:
A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Good questions.
Thoughtful answers.

Everything you need to know about finding your style with VORA.

Get in touch
What is VORA and how does it work?

VORA helps you discover pieces that work with your proportions and personal style. Create a styling profile, explore suggestions curated by our stylists, and find inspiration for your wardrobe.

Do I need to know my body type before using VORA?

No. You can start with photos or measurements. VORA uses the information you provide to suggest a styling profile.

Does VORA tell me what I should or shouldn’t wear?

Our recommendations are suggestions, not rules. Wear what makes you feel like yourself. Your body type is a starting point for exploring clothes, never a limit on your style.

How can I create my styling profile?

Choose one of three options: upload three full-body photos from your library, enter your measurements, or take one live photo with our guided frame. The camera offers instant capture and a 10-second timer.

How accurate is VORA’s AI analysis?

Photo analysis estimates your visible proportions. Lighting, clothing, pose and camera angle can affect the result. It does not provide exact body measurements or a definitive assessment of your body.

What if my body type result doesn’t feel right?

Bodies don’t always fit neatly into categories. Treat your profile as inspiration and explore the suggestions that feel right for you. If something seems wrong, contact us at vorastyling@gmail.com and we’ll help.

How does VORA choose what to recommend?

Our stylists curate the recommendations for each silhouette using proportion, balance and garment shape. The photo tool helps estimate a silhouette; the styling advice comes from our editorial selection.

Will recommended clothes fit me perfectly?

Fit varies between brands, cuts and fabrics. Always check the retailer’s size guide, product details and return policy before purchasing. VORA cannot guarantee the fit of a garment.

Does VORA sell the clothes shown?

No. Product links take you to independent retailers, where you can review availability, prices, shipping and returns. Your purchase is handled by that retailer.

Does VORA earn commissions from purchases?

VORA may earn a commission from purchases made through certain affiliate links, at no additional cost to you.

What information does VORA collect?

Photos and measurements are processed on your device. Your styling category is kept temporarily in your browser session so you can return to your profile. When our contact form is available and you submit it, we save your name, surname, email and subscription choice in a private Google Sheet. We do not send your photos or measurements to that sheet.

Are my photos used to train AI models?

No. In the current MVP, your photos and camera frames are processed locally in your browser. VORA does not upload them or use them to train a model.

Can I request deletion of my information?

Yes. Contact vorastyling@gmail.com to request deletion of contact details you have submitted. Photos and measurements are not stored on VORA’s servers. You can clear your browser session to remove your locally saved styling profile.

Who can access my information?

The VORA team and authorised collaborators can access the private lead sheet when it is connected. Hosting and analytics providers handle ordinary technical visit information. Read our information-handling notice for details.

Can VORA make mistakes?

Yes. Our analysis and recommendations can be imperfect. VORA is a styling tool, and its results should be interpreted as guidance rather than certainty.

What should I do if I have a technical issue?

Email vorastyling@gmail.com with your device, browser and a description of what happened. Please avoid sending body photos or other sensitive information unless it is specifically needed and agreed.

Still have questions?

We’d love to hear from you. Contact vorastyling@gmail.com.

<style>
body { background: #fff; }
.vora-stylists-page { max-width: 1600px; padding: 0 0 80px; background:#fff; }
.vora-stylists-hero { max-width: 960px; padding: 80px 24px 72px; margin: 0 auto; text-align:center; }
.vora-stylists-kicker { font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:2.2px; margin-bottom:20px; }
.vora-stylists-title { max-width: 850px; margin:0 auto 22px; font-family:Georgia,serif; font-size:32px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.25; letter-spacing:0; text-transform:uppercase; }
.vora-stylists-deck,.vora-stylists-note { font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:11px; line-height:1.8; letter-spacing:1.1px; text-transform:uppercase; margin:0; }
.vora-stylists-grid { max-width:1300px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 40px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:0; }
.vora-stylist-portrait { height:620px; min-height:0; aspect-ratio:auto; }
.vora-stylist-image { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:50% 35%; }
.vora-stylist-overlay { opacity:1; background:linear-gradient(transparent 10%,rgba(0,0,0,.75) 62%,rgba(0,0,0,.86)); align-items:flex-end; padding:36px; }
.vora-stylist-bio { font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:14px; line-height:1.75; max-width:530px; }
.vora-stylist-caption { display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:42px 28px 34px; text-align:left; gap:22px; }
.vora-stylist-name { order:2; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:10px; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:.8px; margin:0; }
.vora-stylist-quote { order:1; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:17px; line-height:1.55; font-weight:400; font-style:italic; border:0; padding:0; margin:0; max-width:450px; }
.vora-stylists-tap { display:none; }
.vora-stylist-join { margin:30px auto 0; }
.vora-collage-image { transform:translateY(var(--vora-drift,0px)); }
@media (max-width:767px) { .vora-stylists-hero { padding:56px 24px 54px; } .vora-stylists-title { font-size:25px; } .vora-stylists-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; padding:0 20px; gap:32px; } .vora-stylist-portrait { height:570px; } .vora-stylist-overlay { padding:28px; } .vora-stylist-bio { font-size:13px; } .vora-stylist-caption { padding:28px 8px; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .vora-collage-image { transform:none !important; } }
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  var collage=document.querySelector('.vora-stylist-collage');
  if(!collage)return;
  var reduced=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  var images=collage.querySelectorAll('.vora-collage-image');
  var frame=0,active=false;
  function draw(){frame=0;var rect=collage.getBoundingClientRect();var amount=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(window.innerHeight-rect.top)/(window.innerHeight+rect.height)));images.forEach(function(image,i){image.style.setProperty('--vora-drift',reduced.matches?'0px':Math.round(amount*[36,65,24,50,40][i])+'px');});}
  function schedule(){if(active&&!frame&&!reduced.matches)frame=requestAnimationFrame(draw);}
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window){new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){active=entries[0].isIntersecting;if(active)draw();}).observe(collage);}else{active=true;draw();}
  window.addEventListener('scroll',schedule,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('resize',schedule,{passive:true});
  function preferenceChanged(){draw();}if(reduced.addEventListener)reduced.addEventListener('change',preferenceChanged);
})();
</script>
